I saved a note in EngramDB: on newer versions of wkhtmltopdf, the invoice PDF tests fail unless it's run with `--enable-local-file-access`. Next time those tests fail on a new machine or after an upgrade, that flag is the first thing to check. It didn't conflict with anything already stored.

If your fix only lives in your local setup, CI and other developers could still hit the failure. I can add the flag to the PDF rendering code or config in the repo if you'd like.
